result:
**Fix:** commit `070fa8bc` (PR #743, "RESTWS-1037: Fix PRIVILEGE_DENIED sentinel leaks into serialized lists, causing HTTP 500"). Visit encounters are serialized through list conversion. When the user lacks privilege for some elements, the converter returned the `PRIVILEGE_DENIED` sentinel for each element, and that sentinel ended up inside the serialized list. Jackson then had no serializer for it, which produced "No serializer found for class java.lang.Object". The commit makes any denied element make the whole collection return `PRIVILEGE_DENIED`, and makes the page-level caller skip denied items.

I did not change any files. I read the commit diff and the current source, but I did not run the tests or reproduce the HTTP 500.

**Evidence, best first:**

1. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtil.java` lines 364–420: collection, map and property-list conversion now return `PRIVILEGE_DENIED` when any element is denied (checks at 368, 401 and 414).
2. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/resource/impl/DelegatingResourceDescription.java` lines 246–255: the delegated-collection path returns `PRIVILEGE_DENIED` instead of adding the sentinel to the list.
3. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/resource/impl/BasePageableResult.java` lines 55–59: `toSimpleObject` skips denied results rather than adding them.
4. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/VisitResource1_9.java` lines 130–143: the `encounters` property getter for visits, which feeds the collection path above. This file is unchanged by the fix; it shows where the failing list comes from.
5. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtilPrivilegeTest.java` (new file, 230 lines): regression tests for mixed, all-denied, allowed, map and property-collection cases.

The commit has a single ticket reference, RESTWS-1037, in its message. The grep for that key found no matches in source files.
